found_by: the CI fuzz smoke job, fifth run, read-write mode: AddressSanitizer negative-size-param (size=-16834) in ext4_xattr_ibody_initialize from a setxattr. The runner's artifact did not reproduce on the developer's machine (its create allocates a different inode there); this fixture is crafted to the mechanism instead.

edits.note: 128 + 200 + 4 > 256: every inode created on this volume is born with an in-body area that does not fit it. No metadata_csum, so nothing to restamp.

symptom: The write script's create gave the new file i_extra_isize 200; setxattr's finder returned EIO (patch 0076: header past the inode); the set path took that as 'not initialised yet' and initialised: memset with inode_size - 128 - extra_isize wrapped, AddressSanitizer negative-size-param (size=-72).
fixed_by: patch 0078 -- creation clamps extra_isize to none when it cannot fit, the finder's error goes to the caller, and the initialiser refuses an area that does not fit
reproduce: build/bin/ext4dump mkdir /d; create /d/a; setxattr /d/a user.big <600 bytes> under make test-asan
